Alex (AE): Heads-up: Prospect (MedTech Labs) wants an air-gapped POC. Must haves: vendor or customer-signed bundles, SBOM/provenance, manual-only upgrades, and a short operator runbook. Procurement prefers no monthly billing. Kickoff Fri.
Rina (SE): Ok. Quick facts: 7B q4 ~600MB, 13B q4 ~1.1GB. Runtime/operator ~350MB. We can produce full bundle, runtime+model, or model-only minibundles.
Owen (Infra): Signing key note: we support customer-managed keys. Two onboarding flows: (1) customer signs locally and we verify; (2) we sign if they accept vendor-signed. If they keep keys offline, we need fingerprint exchange (OOB). HSM recommended.
Pri (Solutions): Commercial proposals to draft: (A) Annual subscription + reserved capacity, invoiced annually, includes X minibundles/year; (B) Perpetual license + annual maintenance invoiced annually + per-bundle engineering fees. Add-on: 3 remote assist installs.
Alex (AE): They want explicit maintenance calendar anchors (exact day). Can we commit to predictable windows?
Rina (SE): Yes. We can SOW "first Tuesday" monthly for security patches and "first Wednesday of quarter" for model refreshes. For air-gapped customers we prepare signed minibundles 3 business days before the window.
Owen (Infra): Offline install flow (sample):
```
# verify signature
./rw-offline verify --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz
# dry run
./rw-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz --dry-run
# apply
./rw-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz
```
Rollback is snapshot-based and operator-triggered. No auto-push.
Pri (Solutions): SBOM/provenance: we provide SPDX SBOM and a provenance CSV with artifact name, sha256, sbom filename, signer fingerprint. Example line: `redwood-13b-q4-v1.0.tar.gz, f1e2d3..., redwood-13b-v1.sbom.json, signer: aa:bb:cc`.
deploy-bot: Ticket SALES-3310 created: "MedTech airgap POC - signing, cadence, pricing" assigned to Rina, Pri.
Alex (AE): Action items: Pri to draft two proposal options + SOW with calendar anchors; Rina to produce minibundle size matrix and a 1-p runbook; Owen to prepare HSM/key-onboarding checklist and call out Legal dependencies. I'll send to MedTech before Fri.
Rina (SE): I'll include install time estimates for 10/50/100Mbps and three bundle flavors. Also note q4->q2 option reduces size but needs eval signoff.
Owen (Infra): ETA 48h for HSM checklist.
Alex (AE): Thanks team. Flag anything that's a showstopper ASAP. :white_check_mark:
